title: Pinned tool installer and blocking Zizmor with an expiring allowlist
summary: Creates `bin/security-tools.sh` and `.github/security-tools.lock` (first tool: zizmor), makes `zizmor.yml` blocking (`--persona=pedantic --min-severity=medium --config=.github/zizmor.yml`, no `|| true`), fixes every medium/high finding in the workflows, and records unavoidable ones only in `.github/zizmor.yml` with owner, reason and expiry comments.
why: P0-B (A03): the current job reports 122 findings and always passes. Risks: tool download without hash verification re-opens the supply-chain hole; ignoring a rule wholesale hides new findings; online audits need `GH_TOKEN` (keep it in `env`).

include: `bin/security-tools.sh <name> -- <args>`: kinds `binary` (url + sha256, tar.gz/zip extraction), `wheel` (url + sha256, `python3 -m venv` + `pip install --no-deps <wheel>`), `docker` (`image@sha256:digest`); env overrides `AZGUARD_TOOLS_LOCK` (lock path) and `AZGUARD_TOOLS_DIR` (default `var/tools`); exit 2 on hash mismatch or unknown tool; reads JSON with `python3 -c` (no jq dependency)
`.github/security-tools.lock` with zizmor (latest release; prefer an official linux x86_64 binary asset with published checksum, else the manylinux x86_64 wheel)
`zizmor.yml`: run through the script; triggers per P1.4; checkout pinned and `persist-credentials: false`

Workflow fixes for findings (e.g. `cache-poisoning` on `actions/cache` in jobs reachable from release tags: disable cache in release-called jobs or key it on the lock; `excessive-permissions`; `template-injection`; `artipacked`)
`.github/dependabot.yml`: no change for actions; tools are bumped by editing the lock

reads.why: Branch, commits, owner WIP, frozen-contract stop rule, owner gates, evidence

rules: A finding is fixed in the workflow unless the fix is impossible; each ignore is `file:line` scoped with the comment of knowledge/supply-chain#zizmor and expires ≤ 180 days.
Record the zizmor version, sha256 and the before/after finding counts in `plans/2026.10.17-№1-AZGUARD-FINAL-HARDENING/artifacts/evidence/P1.5/zizmor.md`.
guidance: Run locally: `bash bin/security-tools.sh zizmor -- --persona=pedantic --min-severity=medium --config=.github/zizmor.yml .github/workflows/` (add `--offline` when no `GH_TOKEN`). `gh release view --repo zizmorcore/zizmor --json tagName,assets` lists assets; compute sha256 with `sha256sum` after downloading once and cross-check with the published checksum asset if present.

validation.cmd:
d=$(mktemp -d) && printf 'on: push
permissions: {}
jobs:
  a:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
' > "$d/neg.yml" && ! bash bin/security-tools.sh zizmor -- --persona=pedantic --offline "$d/neg.yml"

t=$(mktemp) && python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(open(".github/security-tools.lock")); d["tools"]["zizmor"]["sha256"]="0"*64; json.dump(d,open(sys.argv[1],"w"))' "$t" && AZGUARD_TOOLS_LOCK="$t" AZGUARD_TOOLS_DIR="$(mktemp -d)" bash bin/security-tools.sh zizmor -- --version; test $? -eq 2

validation.procedure: Push (gate CI-PUSH); ci-runs check for Zizmor

result.notes: zizmor 1.31.1 binary pinned by sha256, blocking, allowlist empty; V6 live ждёт CI-PUSH
deviations: setup-php version comment without v prefix
